exposure: postmenstrual age (PMA) at first breastfeeding attempt
outcome: postmenstrual age (PMA) at first breastfeeding attempt
cohort: The study participants were mothers of 992 preterm infants with a gestational age of 23-36 weeks.
finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding is possible for stable preterm infants, even at low postmenstrual age and while maintained on nasal-CPAP, which should not be a barrier.
